# GSAP vendor files

The landing bundles only the minified GSAP files it uses so animations work without loading a third-party script at page view time.

- GSAP 3.15.0: `gsap.min.js`
- ScrollTrigger: `ScrollTrigger.min.js`
- MotionPathPlugin: `MotionPathPlugin.min.js`

Source package: [gsap on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/gsap), distributed by GreenSock. These files are covered by the [GSAP Standard License](https://gsap.com/standard-license). GSAP remains the property of its owner; the license governs the permitted website use.
